notes.title: Medieval Story - Episode 1, coming soon!
notes.notes:
Medieval Story is about to be released very soon. In the meantime I have uploaded two trailers. One short release trailer/teaser showing some combat action and one trailer that show the game dialogue system.

[i]I hope you like what you see![/i]
